correctness.rationale: The source capacity formula reduces every positive support functional to wA+(1-w)B on the probability simplex. The exact Hessian identities make this objective strictly concave on the simplex tangent space. Boundary asymptotics force the unique optimizer into the interior. The Lagrange equations reduce exactly to two logarithmic odds equations, whose product is psi(x)psi(y)=1. Conversely the product relation plus the displayed weight reconstructs both stationarity equations, and strict concavity gives the unique global optimizer. The monotonicity and endpoint limits of psi prove existence, uniqueness, involution, endpoints, and the golden-ratio fixed point. The verifier numerically checks representative cases but the infinite claim rests on the analytic argument.
risks: The source uses base-two entropy while the KKT derivation uses natural logarithms; the common positive conversion factor is explicitly accounted for.
